data.comment: Label of the run summary line counting distinct tests that ran more than once because of a retry, e.g. 'retried: 2 test(s), 4 extra run(s)'. Keep parallel to the 'failed:'/'succeeded:'/'skipped:' labels. The colon is part of the string so locales can punctuate it appropriately.

data.name: RetriedTestsAndRuns
data.comment: {0} is the number of distinct tests that were retried. {1} is the number of additional executions those retries caused. Rendered after the 'retried:' label.

data.name: FlakyLowercase
data.comment: {0} is the number of tests that failed at least once but eventually passed. Rendered in the run summary after the 'skipped:' line. The parenthetical is important: it states that these tests are already included in the 'succeeded:' count rather than forming a fourth outcome category alongside failed/succeeded/skipped.

data.name: FlakyTests
data.comment: Header of the run summary section that lists tests which failed at least once but eventually passed after a retry.

data.name: FlakyTransition
data.comment: Describes the outcome change of a flaky test, shown next to its name in the 'Flaky tests:' section. The arrow reads left (first outcome) to right (final outcome).

data.name: FlakyAttempts
data.comment: {0} is the total number of times the test ran (first run plus retries), shown next to a flaky test's name.

data.name: SlowestTests
data.comment: Header of the run summary section that lists the longest-running tests.

data.name: HandshakeFailuresHeader
data.comment: Section header printed at the end of a 'dotnet test' run when one or more test hosts failed to hand-shake with the SDK. Followed by per-assembly exit code, stdout and stderr.

data.name: CmdAffectedTestsFeatureDisabled
data.value: Affected-test selection is experimental. Set the '{0}' environment variable to '1' to enable it.

data.name: CmdAffectedTestsOptionsMutuallyExclusive
data.value: The options '--collect-test-map' and '--affected-tests' cannot be used together.

data.name: CmdCollectTestMapCannotRunModulesInParallel
data.value: The option '--collect-test-map' cannot be combined with '--max-parallel-test-modules'. Test maps are collected one module at a time.

data.name: CmdCollectTestMapCannotRequireMinimumTests
data.value: The option '--collect-test-map' cannot be combined with '--minimum-expected-tests'. Collection batches do not report test totals to the parent process.

data.name: CmdAffectedTestsResponseFilesMustBeConsistent
data.value: Forwarded response files must select the same affected-test operation for every test application. Specify '--collect-test-map' or '--affected-tests' directly on 'dotnet test' instead.
